extracted.name: White Wine Sangria
extracted.description: This white wine sangria combines rum and lemon-lime soda with your favorite white wine, apples, and grapes for a deliciously refreshing summer punch.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle lemon-lime soda
1 cup seedless green grapes, or to taste, frozen
instruction_lines: Stir white wine, rum, orange juice, and sugar together in a large pitcher until sugar is dissolved; add apple, lemon, and lime slices. Gently stir lemon-lime soda into the wine mixture.
Put frozen grapes into serving glasses and pour sangria over the grapes.
